qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree with at least 55% marks or Bachelor's degree
qualification.details: Registrar: Master's degree with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade. At least 15 years of experience as an Assistant Professor in the Academic Level-11 and above or with 8 years of service in the Academic Level -12 and above, including as an Associate Professor & at least 5 years of experience as educational administrator. Academic Registrar: Master's degree with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade. At least 15 years of experience as an Assistant Professor in the Academic Level-11 and above or with 8 years of service in the Academic Level -12 and above, including as an Associate Professor & at least 5 years of experience as educational administrator. Controller of Examination: Master's degree with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade. 15 (fifteen) years of administrative experience, of which 8 years shall be as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post. DESIRABLE: Conducting or assisting University/College/Institution Examinations and other allied works at the executive level, having a record justifying entrusting of confidential work, proficiency in the computerisation of Examination Work. Working Knowledge of computers and Networking is mandatory. Deputy Controller of Examination: Master's degree with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade. At least 9 (nine) years of experience as an Assistant Professor. At least 5 (years) of administrative experience. Deputy Registrar: Master's degree with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade. At least 9 (nine) years of experience as an Assistant Professor. At least 5 (years) of administrative experience. Finance Officer: Bachelor's Degree from a recognised University along with at least 8 years of experience in finance And Accounts in a University or Government Organisation, or Public Sector Undertaking. DESIREABLE: Master's Degree in Commerce/Economics/Statistics. Computer literacy to oversee all finance and accounts and stores related matters with good interpersonal skills, knowledge of Tally and/or other relevant software.

salary_details.details: Registrar, Academic Registrar, Controller of Examination: ₹ 1,44,200 - 2,18,200/- (AL - 14) Deputy Controller of Examination, Deputy Registrar: ₹ 78,800 - 2,11,500/- Finance Officer: ₹ 30,000 - 1,10,000/- + G.P 12,700 (PB - 4)

selection_process: Shortlisting based on eligibility criteria Interview
how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.kokrajharuniversity.ac.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 24-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.kokrajharuniversity.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 24-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.
